params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to posts published after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to posts published before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Limit response to posts modified after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_before
params.description: Limit response to posts modified before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to posts with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Sparse fieldset — comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by post attribute.

params.name: categories
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific category term IDs.

params.name: categories_exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes items with specific category term IDs.

params.name: tags
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific tag term IDs.

params.name: tags_exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes items with specific tag term IDs.

params.name: sticky
params.description: Limit result set to items that are sticky.

items.docs: Lists published posts. On this deployment the collection is the company news archive — 19 items from the May 2021 launch through the June 2025 Series D. Paginated; `X-WP-Total` and `X-WP-TotalPages` are exposed via `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`, and a `Link` header carries `rel="next"` / `rel="prev"`.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the object.

params.description: Sparse fieldset — comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves one published post by numeric ID.
